effects.description: The synchronous warm frame is observed exactly once.
A start-time visit switch prevents new old-attempt admission and preserves the new owner.
Accepted decode is retained in audit after hide while retired UI stays silent.
In-order decode advances both audit and visible progress.
Reverse decode records every accepted frame without visible rollback.
Cleanup-select C supersedes outer select B before B starts.
Cleanup-hide supersedes outer select B before B starts.
Frame order, visit handoff, cleanup reentrancy, and split effects remain correct in one trace.
Existing retry ordering, records, notices, and ownership remain intact while visit-wide progress stays monotonic across attempts.
The adjacent telemetry consumer continues to count live deltas without cached panel bootstrap.
Every queue record includes authorized byteCount from file.size.
